criteria.text: Running `pdd lint --local` with Now, Agents, Workflows and Machines drawings and all shared and tab-specific controls present produces no SVG control warnings.
Running `pdd lint --local` when the shared tab-now button is missing from the Agents drawing warns for tab-now on Agents only.
Running `pdd lint --local` when Approve is missing from its Now drawing warns for Approve on Now only.
Running `pdd lint --local` with one linked drawing still warns for every declared control missing from that drawing.
